snippet.title: Character Reveal Trailer | Rottenroots
snippet.description:
In this haunting visual novel, you become Salem - torn between forbidden love and regime loyalty. Make split-second decisions that transform his personality in a solarpunk dystopia. With multiple paths and endings, your choices define who Salem becomes in a world where being different is dangerous! 

SUPPORT THE FULL GAME BY WISHLISTING: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177730/Rottenroots/

Download Episode 1 for FREE on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547500/Rottenroots_Episode_1/

Game made by Klabautermann Games
Trailer cut and edited by Alexej Vekslarski
